groups.A: Hybrid networking & VPC routing (PrivateLink, Direct Connect gateway, prefixes, Lambda in VPC)
groups.B: Cheapest / least-overhead design fit (edge features, serverless, EKS for multi-cloud, PII off-chain)

48.keywords: expose services to other AWS customers privately, off the internet
48.trap: 🔁 5th miss — ALB cannot back a VPC endpoint service (twin options differ only NLB vs ALB)
48.rule: PrivateLink endpoint service → Network Load Balancer (or GWLB), never ALB.

17.keywords: add DX redundancy + reach a NEW VPC in another Region over the same network
17.trap: 🔁 A transit gateway per Region adds parts; DX private VIFs reach other Regions only through a Direct Connect gateway
17.rule: 2nd DX connection + one Direct Connect gateway; a private VIF per connection associated to the DX gateway; VGW per VPC (any Region).

55.keywords: transit VIF, DX gateway + transit gateway, local servers must reach VPCs
55.trap: MACsec / more bandwidth don't fix reachability — it's a routing (prefix) problem
55.rule: DX gateway ↔ TGW association: allowed prefixes must cover (≥) the VPC CIDRs and the VPC prefixes must be advertised.

38.keywords: Lambda must reach Neptune (private subnets) AND DynamoDB
38.trap: Lambda ENIs in a VPC never get public IPs — public subnet + IGW gives no internet/AWS-API access
38.rule: VPC Lambda → private subnets + SG rule to the DB; reach DynamoDB via gateway VPC endpoint or NAT gateway.

22.keywords: users in Asia/Middle East, lower latency, MOST cost-effective
22.trap: Multi-Region copies + geolocation routing = overbuilt; a second stack costs far more
22.rule: Global latency, cheapest → edge features: S3 Transfer Acceleration for uploads + edge-optimized API Gateway endpoint.

39.keywords: monolith REST API, spiky traffic, components use different resources, cost-effective, least operational overhead
39.trap: ASG + ALB still runs and patches EC2 for idle hours
39.rule: Spiky API + least overhead → split into Lambda functions behind API Gateway (custom domain), scale per function.

70.keywords: event-driven serverless + additional clusters on OTHER cloud providers
70.trap: 🔁 ECS is AWS-only; 'multi-cloud clusters' points to Kubernetes
70.rule: Containers that must also run on other clouds → EKS (Kubernetes) on Fargate; ECS only when AWS-only.

44.keywords: patient records on Managed Blockchain, secure, transparent, immutable
44.trap: Name and ID are still PII — any PII on an immutable chain can never be deleted
44.rule: Blockchain + PII → store only a HASH on-chain; PII off-chain (DynamoDB).

8.keywords: EC2 in Account B must assume role in Account A; permission error
8.trap: Trusting Account B's root lets ANY identity in B assume the role — not least privilege (twin options: root vs role ARN)
8.rule: Cross-account: edit the trust policy in the role's own account (A) and trust the specific role ARN of the caller.
